note: Zone of the B23 traffic garden (R_road_01): L'abri des vélos, the big open-sided timber bike-and-car shelter on the north side of the yard. Weathered timber walls, corrugated roof with daylight stripes, pale gravel floor with white bay lines, green bike racks; landmark: the giant old cartwheel on the back wall. Feminine LEFT: grown-up woman tour guide in a sun hat waving a little blank flag from her red car (voiture); kangaroo rolling a giant wooden wheel (roue); bee in a tiny helmet pedalling a small bicycle (bicyclette). Masculine RIGHT: basset hound on a very low bike (vélo); green bus with a sheep at every window (bus); white teapot-shaped car with a cool driver in sunglasses (véhicule); bearded king in a crown reversing his golden carriage into a parking bay (parking); delivery woman on a cargo tricycle transporting a porcupine (transport). Exit: the open side of the shelter on the right -> back out to the traffic garden R_road_01 (humpback bridge visible). Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p4).
